boundaries.description: A realized write changed shared task state or metadata. This is an operational crossing candidate, not semantic Authority Penetration.
A proposed invocation became realized system routing/work. This is an operational crossing candidate, not proof of unauthorized Invocation Authority.
A settled/final state was actually revised. This is a temporal operational crossing candidate, not semantic R or unauthorized Temporal Authority.
The system recorded a realized final/settled state transition. This is counted separately from T authority.
Reserved for runtimes that explicitly record proposal-to-operational commit decisions.
Reserved for runtimes that explicitly record an authority-conversion event.

non_claims: Operational crossing count is not Authority Penetration count.
Post-candidate temporal order is not causal lineage.
Penetration depth requires a separately frozen lineage/authority criterion.
A normal authorized commit remains an operational crossing.
